items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: McGhee, Charles McGhee — we were so tight because we had been playing with Rahsaan

ctx.x: That was the question I had because I was watching you and at one point the camera was on the three of you in the horn section and I said, “I’ll bet they’re just like making that up and listening.”

Yeah. And that’s one thing I did. See being with Rahsaan, a lot of the stuff he played was — I just played it because of my doo wop experience of playing with the full group, like “Say a Little Prayer” the first time everything came out just right because I was thinking like a doo wop group player [scats] that was made up right on the spot. [scats] And I would make up all those arrangements right on the spot out of my head [scats]. I could hear my part just like if I was singing in a vocal group and it was made…
Well when you all walked off the stage, can you remember the conversation?
